name: Lucky
houseDescription: Bone motifs, iron armor, and a retro TV glow — reads like a cozy crypt with surprisingly soft lighting.
description: The mummy-wrapped legend of lazy villagers. Lucky is goofy, food-motivated, and somehow always photogenic on spooky-cute islands.

seo.title: Lucky — Lazy dog
seo.description: The mummy-wrapped legend of lazy villagers. Lucky is goofy, food-motivated, and somehow always photogenic on spooky-cute islands.

acnh.intro: Lucky is a lazy dog villager in the who appears in all games to date. His name is ironic, given how his appearance makes him resemble an injured person wrapped in bandages.
acnh.appearance: Lucky is a black dog wrapped in white bandages like a full-body cast, mummy-soft and slightly uncanny. A glowing yellow left eye shines through the wrappings, with ears and tail peeking out the same pale wrap.
acnh.personality: Lucky's lazy calm makes him instantly approachable — food jokes, gentle naivete, and unhurried friendship that never feels performative. Peppy, smug, and cranky villagers usually mesh with his humor; snooty and jock personalities may clash with his slow lifestyle and love of rest. He sleeps at eleven and wakes at eight, bandaged and unbothered, glowing yellow eye steady through every season.

villagerInfo.quote: Don't bite the hand that feeds you.
